cues.initial: Near-black blue ground. At centre a single wide, thin hairline rounded rectangle (an empty browser address bar, about 60% of the frame wide); at its left end a small closed padlock drawn in green (shackle arc, rounded body, keyhole) with a soft green glow beneath it; a thin caret blinking just right of the lock. The frame corners are clean.
cues.action: On each downbeat frost dendrites (branching cyan-white hairlines) grow a step inward from all four frame corners; the caret blinks on every beat; the lock's glow breathes with the loudness. On bar 2 the padlock gives one small click: the shackle seats a pixel deeper and a thin green ring of light expands from it and fades.
cues.result: The same dark frame with the hairline address bar and the small green padlock glowing at its left end; branching frost hairlines reach about a quarter of the way in from each corner, the centre and bar still clear.
cues.motif: planted: one small green padlock, closed, in an empty address bar

cues.lyric: You sent it on a Tuesday, twenty twenty-one
cues.initial: Dark blue-black frame. One glowing cyan fibre crosses the upper third from left to right, receding slightly toward the right. Halfway along, a small faceted prism housing clamps the fibre, a frost-lined chute dropping from it out of the bottom of frame; beside the housing a small dark reader panel. At the left end a single sealed envelope (a flat white card with folded flap and a small padlock on the seal) sits on the fibre.
cues.action: The envelope hops along the fibre to the right in eased beat-steps, the fibre's light pulsing on each kick. On 'Tuesday,' a mono date stamp thuds onto the envelope's corner with a small settle: "TUE 2021-03-09".
cues.result: The sealed envelope sits on the fibre about a third of the way across, its corner stamped "TUE 2021-03-09" in mono; the prism tap and its dark reader panel wait at centre; the chute below is empty.
cues.motif: the address-bar padlock is now the small lock on the Tuesday envelope's seal, still grey

cues.lyric: A little green padlock said the hard part was done
cues.initial: The stamped Tuesday envelope on the fibre, a third of the way across; its seal padlock small and grey.
cues.action: The camera eases in on the envelope's seal. On 'padlock' the padlock clicks shut and turns green, a thin green ring of light popping off it; the envelope gives a satisfied little bounce and hops on toward the tap.
cues.result: Close on the envelope's flap: the small padlock on the seal glowing green, the date stamp "TUE 2021-03-09" beside it, the fibre's cyan light running beneath; the prism tap visible just ahead on the right.
cues.motif: the padlock clicks green on the envelope: sealed, safe

cues.lyric: I couldn’t read a word of it, I didn’t even try
cues.initial: The green-locked envelope arriving under the prism tap at centre; the reader panel beside it dark.
cues.action: The envelope slides under the tap; a thin scan line sweeps its face. On 'read' the reader panel lights and fills with a dense block of shifting mono hex and noise that churns with the hi-hats and never resolves into words.
cues.result: The envelope under the prism at centre, its green padlock lit; beside it the reader panel full of churning cyan hex digits (e.g. "9F 3A C1 07 E4 …"), unreadable; the fibre glowing on either side.
cues.motif: the padlock holds: the tap sees only ciphertext

cues.lyric: I made myself a copy and I put it on ice
cues.initial: The envelope under the prism tap, the reader churning hex; the frost-lined chute below empty.
cues.action: On 'copy' a translucent ghost of the envelope peels downward off the original (the original hops on along the fibre, untouched). The copy tips into the chute and falls; on 'ice' it hits the chute's floor at the bottom of the frame and frost blooms up the chute walls in a burst of branching white dendrites.
cues.result: The original green-locked envelope riding off to the right along the fibre; below the tap the chute's walls thickly furred with frost, the pale copy lying in it, its padlock a frosted, colourless twin.
cues.motif: the copy's padlock is a pale, frosted twin of the green one

cues.lyric: I don’t have to break you
cues.initial: Darkness in a cold room: one steel rack of small drawers lit by a single cold-blue strip light, the rest lost in fog; low mist on the floor. Drawer 0001, at eye level, stands open; the frosted copy of the Tuesday envelope slides down into it.
cues.action: The camera glides close past the open drawer. On 'break' a cold glint runs across the frosted padlock on the envelope (a single bright specular streak), the lock untouched and whole.
cues.result: Close on drawer 0001: inside, the pale envelope lies flat, its frosted padlock catching one bright glint; the drawer's frosted glass front and steel frame fill the right half; fog and darkness behind.
cues.motif: the frosted padlock filed in drawer 0001, glinting, unbroken

cues.lyric: I only have to keep you
cues.initial: Drawer 0001 open with the frosted envelope inside; one rack lit, fog around it.
cues.action: The camera pulls back a step. On 'keep' the drawer slides shut with a small settle, frost creeps across its glass front, and its mono tag prints "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09" while its status lamp turns on pale. Behind it more racks fade up out of the fog, one by one.
cues.result: A shut drawer with a frosted glass front and a lit mono tag "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09" in the right of frame; behind, a short aisle of steel racks faintly lit in cold blue, fading into fog; low floor mist.
cues.motif: drawer 0001 shut on the frosted padlock: kept

cues.lyric: I’ll wait for you, I’ve got the time
cues.initial: The full aisle in amber: two tall walls of drawers receding into fog toward a vanishing point at centre, frost on every glass front with an amber status lamp behind each, cold strip lights overhead; many drawers stand open.
cues.action: Two rack-end counters frame the aisle mouth, rolling up from 00124; the camera dollies past them into the aisle a step per bar. On 'time' a wave of drawers slams shut from the camera toward the vanishing point, each lamp flicking amber as it closes; the counters (now behind the camera) roll to 00412.
cues.result: A deep symmetrical aisle of shut, frosted drawers, hundreds of small amber lamps glowing behind frost on both walls, cold strip lights overhead; fog at the far end.
cues.motif: hundreds of frosted padlocks fill the aisle

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: The amber aisle, drawers shut; small square chutes open in the ceiling above both walls.
cues.action: Sealed envelopes drop from the ceiling chutes into drawers that spring open to catch them, on the beats, faster and faster along the aisle; on 'mine' every drawer in view slams shut at once and all the amber lamps flare together.
cues.result: Both walls of drawers shut and frosted, every amber lamp at full glow, a few late envelopes still falling from the ceiling chutes at the far end; the rack-end tag reads "01930".
cues.motif: every envelope filed; the padlocks all frosted

cues.lyric: I’ll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: The amber aisle at full glow; the camera moving toward the end of one rack.
cues.action: The camera swings round the end of a rack to face its end panel, where a large mono drawer counter spins; on 'later' it stops on "08811" and the camera settles.
cues.result: The steel end panel of a rack filling the left half of the frame, a mono counter "08811" in amber on it; to the right the aisle recedes into fog, amber lamps behind frost.
cues.motif: five figures of frosted padlocks

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: A warm black frame, empty.
cues.action: The line is set huge in capitals, left-aligned, word by word as it is sung; HARVEST lands in gold on 'Harvest', LATER also in gold.
cues.result: "HARVEST NOW, DECRYPT LATER" in heavy warm-white capitals across the frame on warm black, HARVEST and LATER in gold.
cues.motif: the collector's creed; no padlock on screen

cues.initial: Back inside the cold room's aisle, amber lamps behind frost on both walls, only a few of them lit, some drawers standing open; hung from the ceiling over the aisle on two rods, a dark steel gauge panel: the mono kicker "COLD STORAGE · USED" above a big gold reading "0.0 PB" and an empty fill bar. The camera pushes slowly toward it, a step per bar.
cues.action: On bar 27 the reading rolls up to 0.1 PB, the label "one Tuesday" appears under it and a sliver of the fill bar lights; a quarter of the open drawers slam shut in a wave down the aisle and the lamps flare.
cues.result: The hanging gauge in the upper middle of the frame reading "0.1 PB", "one Tuesday", its bar barely started; below it the aisle recedes into fog, a scatter of amber lamps lit on the drawer walls.
cues.motif: the archive's fill as a reading

cues.initial: The gauge at "0.1 PB", "one Tuesday".
cues.action: On bar 29 the reading rolls to 4.7 PB, the label switching to "one company"; another wave of drawers slams shut and more amber lamps come on down the aisle.
cues.result: The gauge a little closer: "4.7 PB" in gold, label "one company", the fill bar a fifth along; more of the aisle's lamps lit.
cues.motif: the archive's fill climbing

cues.initial: The gauge at "4.7 PB", "one company".
cues.action: On bar 31 the reading rolls fast to 310 PB; label "one ministry"; drawers slam, the lamps flare and more stay lit.
cues.result: The gauge reading "310.0 PB", label "one ministry", the fill bar past halfway; most of the aisle's amber lamps now lit.
cues.motif: the archive's fill climbing

cues.initial: The gauge at "310.0 PB", "one ministry".
cues.action: On bar 32 the reading rolls into four figures, 9,400 PB; label "one continent"; the last open drawers slam and every lamp in the aisle comes on; it holds there to the cut.
cues.result: The gauge large in the upper middle of the frame: "9,400.0 PB" under "COLD STORAGE · USED", label "one continent", the fill bar full; both walls of the aisle glowing with amber lamps behind frost.
cues.motif: four figures of petabytes on ice

cues.lyric: They’re stacking up the qubits, a few more every year
cues.initial: Under cold white work lights, a bare frame of thin rods at centre with two plain circular plates hung on it; a small square chip at the bottom with a grid of mostly dark dots; mono readouts beside it: "300 K" and "QUBITS 53".
cues.action: On each beat a new plate bolts onto the frame below the last with a small bounce, and a new row of the chip's dots lights; the qubit readout steps 53 → 127 → 433; on 'qubits,' the fifth and smallest plate bolts on and the readout lands "QUBITS 1121". The frame then turns slowly.
cues.result: A bare five-stage frame of stacked circular plates, each smaller than the one above, on thin rods at centre, unlit metal under work lights; the chip at the bottom with its grid of dots lit cyan; readouts "300 K" and "QUBITS 1121".
cues.motif: the padlocks are out of frame; the machine to open them is being built

cues.lyric: The experts said a decade, now the decade’s nearly here
cues.initial: The five-stage bare frame turning slowly; a new small mono readout "Q-DAY ETA 10 yr" appears at the right.
cues.action: The ETA readout counts down fast, 10 → 9 → 8 … 1 yr, with the hats; on 'decade’s' it snaps to "Q-DAY ETA near", and the work lights blink once.
cues.result: The bare five-plate frame at centre-left, chip lit; on the right the mono readout "Q-DAY ETA near" under "QUBITS 1121" and "300 K".
cues.motif: the machine is nearly ready; the archive waits

cues.lyric: You changed all of your passwords, you think that sees you through
cues.initial: The glowing fibre across the upper third, now dense: dozens of sealed envelopes hop along it in a stream, each passing under the prism tap; below it the frost-lined chute takes a steady drop of translucent copies.
cues.action: On 'passwords,' every padlock on the envelopes riding the fibre re-keys at once: a ripple of green clicks runs left to right along the wire, each lock flashing a fresh green; the frosted copies already in the chute below stay pale and unchanged.
cues.result: Upper third: a stream of envelopes with bright green padlocks along the cyan fibre; lower half: the chute packed with pale envelopes whose frosted padlocks are colourless and unchanged.
cues.motif: new green padlocks above; the old frosted copies below do not change

cues.lyric: But a blueprint or a birthday stays as true as true
cues.initial: The busy wire above, the frosted chute below.
cues.action: The camera dips down into the chute. On 'blueprint' one old envelope turns face-up: through its frost a faint line drawing of a building floor plan shows; on 'birthday' a second one beside it shows a cake with candles and a date. Both carry a mono tag "valid: forever".
cues.result: Inside the frosted chute: two pale envelopes side by side, one showing a faint cyan line drawing of a floor plan through the frost, the other a cake with candles; under each a mono tag "valid: forever".
cues.motif: the frosted copies keep what never expires

cues.lyric: They handed you the new math
cues.initial: Dark frame; a sparse 3D lattice of faint points joined by hairlines, rotating slowly; a small mono label in the corner "ML-KEM · FIPS 203 · 2024".
cues.action: Shells of lattice points light green outward from the origin on each beat; on 'math' the whole lattice snaps into full crystal and one short bright vector from the origin flares.
cues.result: A complete crystalline lattice of green-lit points and hairlines filling the centre, a single short bright green vector from its origin; the corner label "ML-KEM · FIPS 203 · 2024".
cues.motif: a new kind of lock, the lattice, handed over

cues.lyric: You said you’d get around to that
cues.initial: The full green lattice turning, its short vector bright.
cues.action: The lattice folds down plane by plane into a plain cardboard crate; on 'that' a stamp slams onto the crate's side, "LATER" in heavy condensed capitals, and the crate slides off into the dark at the right.
cues.result: A plain cardboard crate stamped "LATER" in condensed capitals, sliding out at the right edge into darkness; the lattice gone; only the corner label remains.
cues.motif: the new lock, boxed and stamped LATER

cues.lyric: I’ll wait for you, I’ve got the time
cues.initial: Warm black. The chandelier complete at centre: five gold-plated circular plates on rods, coax lines spiralling between them, the chip at the bottom; readouts beside the plates; below, out of focus, rows of frosted drawers with their padlocks. It turns slowly; readout "50 K".
cues.action: Plates flash a rim light top to bottom on the downbeats; on 'time' the temperature readout drops to "4 K" and frost creeps a little up the lowest plate's rods.
cues.result: The gold chandelier at centre, rim-lit, turning; the readout beside it "4 K"; the blurred frosted drawers below.
cues.motif: the frosted padlocks wait under the chandelier

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: The turning gold chandelier at "4 K".
cues.action: The camera tilts down the coax spirals toward the chip; on 'mine' the readout drops to "800 mK" and the chip's qubit grid glows gold.
cues.result: Lower stages of the chandelier filling the frame, coax coils catching gold light, the chip glowing gold at the bottom; readout "800 mK".
cues.motif: the padlocks below, frosted, waiting

cues.lyric: I’ll see you sooner or later
cues.initial: Close on the lower stages, readout "800 mK".
cues.action: The camera keeps tilting down past the chip until the frosted drawers below come into focus, the chandelier hanging above them; on 'later' the readout drops to "100 mK".
cues.result: Frosted drawer fronts with pale padlocks in focus in the lower half; the gold chandelier hanging above them, blurred; readout "100 mK".
cues.motif: the frosted padlocks, close, under the machine

cues.lyric: Harvest now, decrypt later
cues.initial: Frosted drawers in focus under the hanging chandelier; readout "100 mK".
cues.action: The readout drops to "20 mK"; on 'decrypt' a single hairline crack runs across one frosted padlock behind a drawer front, with a tiny bright tick of light.
cues.result: One frosted padlock large in the centre behind its drawer glass, a thin bright crack across its body; the chandelier glowing gold above; readout "20 mK".
cues.motif: first crack: a hairline across one frosted padlock

cues.initial: The full chandelier at centre, all five gold plates lit, turning; the cracked padlock below.
cues.action: The chandelier hums alone; on each downbeat one plate dims to black, top to bottom; on bar 56 the last plate and the chip go dark.
cues.result: A near-black frame: the chandelier only a faint silhouette of plates and rods, its readout "20 mK" the last thing lit.
cues.motif: the cracked padlock in the dark below

cues.initial: Flat paper-white daylight: a kanban board seen straight on, column headers "Q3 2022", "Q4 2022", "Q1 2023" across the top, the columns empty.
cues.action: On bar 57 the board snaps into place with a small settle, ruled column lines drawing down.
cues.result: An empty daylight kanban board, quarter headers along the top, thin grey column rules, no cards yet.
cues.motif: the defenders' office; no padlock

cues.lyric: Ticket opened, priority low
cues.initial: The empty daylight board, column "Q3 2022" at the left.
cues.action: A large ticket card drops into the Q3 2022 column on 'opened,' and its fields fill in: "PQC-114 · Migrate key exchange to post-quantum", an assignee circle, a crate icon as attachment; on 'low' a red "LOW" chip stamps onto the card.
cues.result: One big white card in the Q3 2022 column: "PQC-114", "Migrate key exchange to post-quantum", a grey assignee circle, a small crate icon stamped LATER, and a red "LOW" chip.
cues.motif: the boxed lattice is the ticket's attachment

cues.lyric: Pushed to next quarter, four years in a row
cues.initial: The PQC-114 card in the Q3 2022 column.
cues.action: The card is shoved one column right on every half-beat with a small paper skid, the quarter headers sliding past behind it (Q4 2022, Q1 2023 … Q2 2026); a "Moved" counter on the card ticks up; on 'row' it lands in "Q3 2026" reading "Moved 16×".
cues.result: The card, slightly askew from its last skid, under the header "Q3 2026"; a small counter on it "Moved 16×"; the red LOW chip and crate icon still on it.
cues.motif: the lattice crate pushed quarter after quarter

cues.lyric: Somebody asked, “Who’d even store it?”
cues.initial: The PQC-114 card in Q3 2026, "Moved 16×".
cues.action: A comment box opens under the card, a small avatar circle at its left, and types itself: "who'd even store it?"; on 'store' a thumbs-up reaction pops on with the count 3.
cues.result: Under the card, a small comment: "who'd even store it?" with a thumbs-up and "3"; the card above with LOW chip and crate icon, in flat daylight.
cues.motif: the defenders doubt the archive exists

cues.lyric: Petabytes, darling. I adore it.
cues.initial: Cold room, amber lamps: tight on one frosted drawer front filling the frame, its padlock pale behind the glass.
cues.action: On 'Petabytes,' the camera starts a long pullback up and out: the drawer becomes a rack, the rack an aisle, the aisle one line among hundreds of racks laid out like a city grid under a dark ceiling, amber lamps as city lights; a wall tag swings into view, "31,000 PB".
cues.result: High overhead view of an endless grid of racks receding into fog, thousands of tiny amber lamps behind frost; a mono wall tag "31,000 PB" in the upper corner.
cues.motif: an endless field of frosted padlocks

cues.lyric: I waited for you, I had the time
cues.initial: The gold chandelier at centre, turning, frost on its outer rods, readout "20 mK"; the chip's qubit grid partly lit.
cues.action: Qubit dots light row by row with the beats; on 'time' the readout settles at "10 mK · BASE" and every qubit on the chip is lit.
cues.result: The gold chandelier at centre, frost on its rods, every dot on the chip at the bottom lit gold; readout "10 mK · BASE".
cues.motif: the machine at base temperature above the cracked padlocks

cues.lyric: Every byte you ever sent is mine
cues.initial: The chandelier at base, all qubits lit.
cues.action: Gold light runs down the coax spirals from the top plate to the chip; on 'mine' the frosted drawers below (out of focus) all light amber at once, the machine claiming them.
cues.result: The gold chandelier with glowing coax spirals at centre; below it a wide band of blurred drawers, every lamp amber; readout "10 mK · BASE".
cues.motif: every frosted padlock in the archive lit, claimed

cues.lyric: The fridge hums low, the key falls out
cues.initial: The chandelier at base, drawers glowing below.
cues.action: On 'hums' the stages shiver with a low visible wobble; the chip's lit dots rearrange into the outline of a toothed key; on 'falls' the key drops out of the bottom of the chip, spinning slightly, and falls out of the frame.
cues.result: The chandelier above, its chip now dark with a key-shaped gap of unlit dots; a toothed key of gold dots in mid-fall in the lower frame, heading out of the bottom edge.
cues.motif: the key falls toward the padlocks

cues.lyric: So that’s what you were on about
cues.initial: The cold aisle in blue-black, drawers frosted, padlocks pale; at the far end a wall of flat white daylight starts to roll toward the camera.
cues.action: The daylight wave sweeps down the aisle, the frost retreating from every drawer front in one fast pass; on 'about' the padlocks behind the glass spring open in a chain down the aisle, shackles flipping up one after another.
cues.result: A flat paper-white aisle of clear glass drawer fronts, every padlock open with its shackle up, small red broken seals; ink-dark rack lines in daylight.
cues.motif: padlocks spring open in a chain down the aisle

cues.lyric: I said sooner or later
cues.initial: The white aisle of open padlocks; the camera approaching drawer 0001, its tag "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09".
cues.action: Drawer 0001 slides open first; the Tuesday envelope lifts out and its flap unfolds; on 'later' the letter opens flat into ruled lines of handwriting-like strokes (illegible ink lines, a date in serif italic at the top).
cues.result: Drawer 0001 open at the left with its tag "0001 · TUE 2021-03-09"; at centre an unfolded white page of ruled ink lines, an italic serif date at its top, an open padlock and broken red seal beside it.
cues.motif: drawer 0001 opens first: the Tuesday envelope, the plant paid off

cues.lyric: Harvested then, decrypted now
cues.initial: The unfolded Tuesday page at centre, drawer 0001 open.
cues.action: On 'decrypted' every drawer in the aisle opens at once and envelopes unfold into line drawings (blueprints, cakes, ruled letters); over the long held "now" the camera rises up and over the racks, revealing a whole white city of open drawers and unfolded pages.
cues.result: High overhead view in flat daylight: a vast grid of open drawers and thousands of small unfolded white pages with ink line drawings, red broken seals scattered across them.
cues.motif: every padlock open, every page readable

cues.initial: The white city of open drawers from above.
cues.action: The pages settle; from bar 85 the daylight drains toward a single point at centre, the frame darkening around it.
cues.result: A dark frame with one small point of white light at the centre, the open archive barely visible around it.
cues.motif: the open archive fades to a point

cues.lyric: Connection secure.
cues.initial: Near-black blue ground: the hairline address bar at centre, the small green padlock at its left end, closed and intact, glowing; the frame corners clean of frost.
cues.action: On 'secure.' the padlock gives its small click and a tiny tooltip opens under it, "Connection secure"; then one last thin thread of frost creeps in from the lower-left corner.
cues.result: The dark address bar with the small glowing green padlock, a small tooltip "Connection secure" beneath it, and a single frost hairline reaching in from the lower-left corner.
cues.motif: the little green padlock again, closed, intact: telling the truth, today
